mechanism: Phenelzine is a non-selective MAOI with potential to inhibit monoamine oxidase metabolism of tyramine and other amines, while lansoprazole may have minor serotonergic effects and both drugs can affect gastric pH and drug absorption.
action: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms and hypertensive episodes; use combination cautiously and consider alternative antidepressant if possible; counsel on dietary tyramine restriction.
